decision: One component per controlled CAL run; MAIN review required before the next component.
The first controlled CAL run is DG_PARTICIPATION only.
Participation primary log-loss is evaluated directly from predicted probabilities; 32 stochastic replicates are used for realization-based share guardrails/propagation evidence.
Downstream components require ISOLATED and PROPAGATED views after upstream selection.
Within-family grid selection: hard/guardrail eligible then lowest primary metric, lexical grid_id tie-break.
Sequential promotion is REF->best A then current incumbent->best B.
PART_B sigmoid calibration is post family/grid selection; it cannot rescue a non-selected PART_B family.
No TEST read/opening is authorized by F3.4a or any component CAL run.
Each component produces a RunBundle and freezes its selected artifact before the next component starts.
Joint selected-vs-all-reference CAL gate runs only after all five components are selected.
